cards.headline: Two music videos, two wildly different worlds
cards.snippet: Jamie xx's "Gosh" has two very different music videos. The first, directed by Erik Wernquist, came out on YouTube on 27 April 2015, a week before the single's release on 4 May. It follows the terraforming and colonization of Mars across a long stretch of time. It ends on a planet that has been fully terraformed.

cards.headline: Kids with dyed hair, boot-camp training, no CGI
cards.snippet: In 2016, a making-of film for Romain Gavras's video for Jamie xx's "Gosh" was released. Kim Chapiron directed it. The Gavras video was shot in Hangzhou, in China's Zhejiang province, in a district with a replica Eiffel Tower. It used no CGI or 3D effects. The film shows the 400-person cast having their hair dyed and going through serious training. They then march through the streets. Other cast members sing karaoke in smoky side-rooms, and locals dance nearby.
cards.context: Gavras's video was shot around a replica Eiffel Tower in China; making-of released October 2016.
